SETUP: MANET nodes using LoRa/ESP32 modules powered by Li-ion batteries (≥70%). Gateway connected to terrestrial network via Wi-Fi/Ethernet while LEO satellite link remains in standby. Nodes placed with stable inter-node signal strength (RSSI ≥ -78 dBm but not beyond -120 dBm).
PROCEDURE:
1. Power on MANET nodes and gateway.
2. Allow nodes to auto-discover and form MANET.
3. Transmit periodic text packets between nodes.
4. Monitor link status of all nodes after activation.
MEASURED PARAMETERS: RSSI, SNR, hop count, packet delivery rate, end-to-end latency.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: Packet delivery rate ≥95%. Satellite backhaul remains inactive throughout the test. MANET must form autonomously within 30 seconds of startup.

SETUP: Same configuration as baseline test. Signal degradation introduced by increasing node distance (150–200 ft) or using RF attenuation to reduce signal strength.
PROCEDURE:
1. Gradually degrade signal quality between nodes.
2. Continue until RSSI falls below -78 dBm for 10 seconds.
3. Observe system logs and routing behavior.
MEASURED PARAMETERS: RSSI trends over time, degradation detection time, routing path changes.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: RSSI must drop below -78 dBm to simulate degradation. Total loss of terrestrial/cellular signal acts as the failover trigger.

SETUP: MANET operational while gateway is connected to a LEO satellite terminal. Terrestrial connection intentionally disabled or degraded to force failover activation.
PROCEDURE:
1. Nodes detect terrestrial connectivity failure and enter emergency mode.
2. Node closest to satellite gateway acts as relay node.
3. Establish LEO-MANET link configuration.
MEASURED PARAMETERS: Failover trigger time node disconnection status gateway backhaul status.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: All 4/4 MANET nodes must detect disconnection before LEO satellite backhaul activates. Failover trigger time set to 10 seconds.

SETUP: Full system deployed with battery-powered nodes and operational gateway. Controlled degradation events introduced to simulate emergencies.
PROCEDURE: System runs continuously for 24 hours, transitioning between normal operation, degraded MANET state, and satellite failover. Logs collected for system health and routing performance.
MEASURED PARAMETERS: System uptime, battery levels, routing stability, metric monitoring continuity.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: System must maintain ≥80% uptime over 24 hours. Adaptive routing must remain operational with no crashes, deadlocks, or unrecoverable failures.

TEST CAMPAIGN: Recovery and Reversion to Terrestrial Network
SETUP: System initially operating in satellite routing mode. Terrestrial connectivity restored with RSSI ≥ -78 dBm.
PROCEDURE:
1. Restore terrestrial connectivity.
2. Maintain RSSI above threshold for 10 seconds.
3. Observe routing transition back to terrestrial network.
MEASURED PARAMETERS: Recovery detection time, route switching time, packet loss during recovery.
ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA: System must automatically revert to terrestrial routing, deactivate satellite backhaul, and complete switching within 5 seconds with no message loss.
